title: identity.org.entitlements_changed.v1
description: The plan or the limits of an org changed (synthwerk#31). It carries the full new state, so a consumer needs no call back. CloudEvents subject and orgid extension: the org id. A consumer keeps the highest version per org and drops older events.

plan.description: Plan name. `free` today; paid plans come in M5. A consumer reads limits, never the name.

limits.description: Limits of the plan. 0 means no limit. A day is a UTC day.

llm_tokens_per_user_per_day.description: LLM tokens one user may use in this org per UTC day.

llm_tokens_per_org_per_day.description: LLM tokens all users of the org may use together per UTC day.

version.description: Goes up by one on every change of this org. Same value as the HTTP API.

reason.description: plan_assigned: the org got its first plan (new org, or an org from before #31). plan_defaults_changed: the limits of its plan changed.
